description: Delete a short link. This can't be undone: the short URL stops working immediately, anyone who already has it gets a 404, and the link leaves the account's list. Its short URL is never given to another link. Prefer update_link with paused:true if the link might be needed again. Requires an API key.

linkId.description: Optional. Needed only when more than one of your links uses this short code, on different hosts: the call then fails with SLUG_AMBIGUOUS and lists each link's linkId. Call again with the same slug and the linkId of the link you mean.

slug.description: The link's short code (the part after the domain).

name: delete_link
title: Delete a short link
